skip_explicit: Generic skillcapes one-per-skill essay — too broad; rack + max-cape perk slots cover passive perk infrastructure without listing every cape

equipment_additions.name: Silverhawk boots (Agility XP from feathers/down)
requirements: 750 Thaler at Stanley Limelight Traders for the boots (wiki: not available to Ironman Mode)
Silverhawk feathers (tradeable GE/TH history) or silverhawk down (untradeable) to charge — 1 feather or 1 down = 1 charge
Up to 1,000 charges stored on the boots
Defence level selectable 1 / 20 / 40 / 50 / 60 via Change level (cosmetic tier stats only — XP effect is charge-based)
unlocks: Permanent hybrid boots that spend charges for Agility XP equal to 10% of a small XP lamp per charge (wiki), while running (1 charge / minute running), using ultimates in combat (45s cooldown), or regularly while skilling (max 1 charge / 45s)
Alternate nimble-boots slot for the nimble outfit set bonus if nimble boots are already owned
Charge supply: 10 silverhawk down for 35 Thaler at Stanley Limelight; also historical Menaphite gift offerings / Uncharted Isles down (down is pointless for ironmen without boots)
Does not re-emit cross-region:thaler-skilling-rewards outfit stock — this row is the Agility-boot equipment residual only
region_pressure: No single hard region for the permanent item once bought — Thaler comes from Spotlight minigames across unlocked regions.
Asgarnia optional: richest default ironman/main Thaler geography (FPF / Pest Control / Gamers' Grotto adjacency) and Stanley shop presence.
Kandarin / Misthalin / Morytania / Karamja / Fremennik optional: other Spotlight-eligible minigame entries for Thaler farm.
equipment_additions.notes: Was only a one-line unlock bullet under cross-region:thaler-skilling-rewards. Ironman Mode cannot buy boots or thaler down packs (wiki shop footnotes) — planner should gate this row as main-account / non-iron Agility supply, not ironman core. Do not invent coins-per-XP tables or Dojo Mojo rates (wiki: boots do not roll the Agility pet).
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Score Thaler minigame access by unlocked regions. Asgarnia is the default Thaler hub pressure. Hard-exclude from ironman League plans.

requirements: Complete all quests / maximum quest points for the Quest Cape achievement (current wiki maximum quest points tracked on the cape page)
99,000 coins purchase from Wise Old Man in Draynor Village (Misthalin)
Cape unequips when new quests release until they are completed; reclaim free from Wise Old Man if bank/inventory full
unlocks: Activate perk: +30 seconds in Tears of Guthix D&D (skilling residual XP for the lowest skill)

Can be stored on Anachronia skillcape rack for Tears-of-Guthix duration perk without wearing the cape
Can be consumed into max/completionist cape perk slots like other Capes of Accomplishment (quest cape is returned if requirements drop)
region_pressure: Misthalin hard-owns Wise Old Man purchase and Draynor reclaim geography.
Asgarnia optional: Fountain of Heroes teleport destination / Heroes' Guild recharge adjacency.
Kandarin optional: Tears of Guthix / Lumbridge swamp cave access pathing historically games-necklace adjacent.
